task.notes: Diagnostic E26: the second profile jump.

floor.what: the organisers' floor: the reference's 10% working copy (copy_last or wt_identity)

fgw_aligned_mix.what: fgw_aligned_series' cells and positions with a uniformly random half of the rows (floor(n / 2)) carrying fgw_aligned_series' expression and the others fgw_aligned_trend's (try H16's within-file mixture)
rule: series: the shallower bracket's drawn cells are moved by a per-gene factor and then to the deeper bracket's depth (RENDER_RULE, hi). The factor is the T3 script's gene_factor over the cell-type labels that both brackets hold by name with at least SERIES_MIN_CELLS cells each and that are extraembryonic (a name starting with EXE-, or the lineage group ExtraEmbryonicMeso): the ratio of the two brackets' share-weighted mean within-cell panel proportions, weights the shallower bracket's label shares, eps 1e-5, rescaled so the weighted total proportion is unchanged, clipped to 0.25-4. It is applied in count space (binomial thinning below 1, Poisson top-up from the cell's kNN-smoothed proportions above 1). The deeper bracket's cells stay as released

trend render: each bracket's drawn cells are moved by a per-gene factor to the run profile a trend through every sample of the task gives at the target's day. A sample's profile is its share-weighted mean within-cell panel proportions over the labels every sample holds with at least SERIES_MIN_CELLS cells that are extraembryonic as SERIES_RULE says (the before bracket's groups), weights the moved bracket's label shares; the trend is the least-squares line of log(profile + 1e-5) on the stage day, read at the target's day; the factor is exp(trend) / (own profile + 1e-5), rescaled so the weighted total proportion is unchanged and clipped to 0.25-4, applied in count space (binomial thinning below 1, Poisson top-up from the cell's kNN-smoothed proportions above 1; vec.core.apply_gene_factor). Depth is not moved: the counts outside the panel stay as released
